I avoided any disclosure of client bottom-line information and kept the changes limited to the draft provided.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thanks for the first draft. We made a few clean-up edits to make the NDA more standard and workable from both sides: clarified the mutual nature of the obligations, sharpened the purpose language, and aligned the term/protection provisions so the agreement is clear and commercially practical. Please take a look and let us know if you’d like us to conform the rest of the document to this version.

edits.text: PARTIES. This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (this “Agreement”) is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures (each, a “Party,” and together, the “Parties”).
edits.name: parties

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE. The Parties wish to explore a potential transaction between them (the “Purpose”) and may share confidential and proprietary information in connection with that Purpose.
edits.name: purpose

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS. Each receiving Party shall protect the disclosing Party’s Confidential Information using at least the same degree of care it uses to protect its own confidential information, but no less than a reasonable degree of care, and shall use such information solely for the Purpose.
edits.name: confidentiality

edits.text: 3. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four (24) months from the date of signing; provided, however, that each Party’s obligation to protect Confidential Information disclosed during the term will continue for three (3) years from the date of disclosure, except for trade secrets, which will be protected for so long as they remain trade secrets under applicable law.
edits.name: term

edits.text: 4. REMEDIES. The Parties acknowledge that unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages may be an insufficient remedy, and that the non-breaching Party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief, in addition to any other remedies available at law or in equity.
edits.name: remedies
